name: post bridge - social media scheduler
description:
Post Bridge is a social media scheduler and publishing tool. Schedule, publish and cross-post content to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky and Google Business Profile from one connected account, using each platform's official API.

From Claude you can: list your connected social accounts, create a post for one or many platforms with a shared or per-platform caption, publish now or schedule for later in your timezone, save drafts, upload images and video from a public URL, request an upload link so a video or a batch of photos on your phone or laptop can be posted, add a first comment on X, Instagram, Facebook and Threads, set YouTube tags, check per-platform publish results, and pull views, likes and comments for what you have published. Fourteen tools in total.

Media rules are enforced for you: Instagram needs a professional account and 1 to 10 items, YouTube exactly one video, LinkedIn takes images, one video or a PDF document carousel, X strips links from the body so put them in the first comment.

Setup: connect your social accounts once at post-bridge.com, then add this connector and sign in. Guide with real screenshots: post-bridge.com/claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add post bridge - social media scheduler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add post bridge - social media scheduler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.post-bridge.com/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the post bridge - social media scheduler MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: post bridge - social media scheduler lists 13 MCP tools, including create_post, delete_media, delete_post, get_analytics_daily, get_post, list_analytics, list_media, list_post_results, list_posts, list_social_accounts, sync_analytics, and update_post.
